facts.note: At the temple's nine, Aurèle inspected the watches and Vauthier's was two minutes ahead of the bell. The transcript states this with the same timepiece and relation.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch, then he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat. Madame began playing as he left and stopped when he returned. All of this matches the sheet.
At the temple's ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and he remarked on it to Madame. The transcript matches.
